title: tetraneuris turneri
intro: Tetraneuris turneri, commonly known as Rock Rose, is a flowering plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of Rock Rose include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. These constituents may also contribute to its antioxidant and anti-cancer properties, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy in these areas.
